procedures.procedureDescription:
The loader chain drive transports logs or billets to the extrusion press. It typically
consists of:
- Drive motor and gearbox
- Chain and sprockets
- Chain guides and tensioning devices
- Bearings and support frames

Inspection Frequency:

- Daily: Visual inspection and abnormal noise check
- Weekly: Chain tension and lubrication check
- Quarterly: Detailed mechanical inspection

Inspection and Maintenance Tasks:
Chain and Sprockets
- Inspect chains for elongation, wear, cracks, or corrosion
- Check sprockets for hooked or worn teeth
- Measure chain elongation; replace if elongation exceeds manufacturer limits

Tensioning System
- Verify proper chain tension
- Adjust tension evenly on both sides to prevent misalignment
- Inspect tensioners for free movement and wear

Drive Components
- Inspect motor and gearbox mounting bolts for tightness
- Check gearbox for oil leaks and correct oil level
- Monitor gear noise and vibration

Lubrication:
- Use only approved chain lubricants
- Lubricate chain while slowly rotating (when safe and permitted)
- Do not over-lubricate, as excess lubricant attracts debris

Alignment:
- Ensure sprockets are aligned within tolerance
- Correct misalignment to prevent premature chain wear
procedures.procedurePath: Extrusion Press\Loader & Safety Systems\Loader Chain Drive

procedures.procedureDescription:
The log flipper is used to orient or reposition logs/billets before feeding into the press. It
may be actuated hydraulically, pneumatically, or electromechanically.
Inspection Frequency:
? Daily: Visual inspection and functional check
? Weekly: Mechanical and actuator inspection
? Semi-Annual: Detailed system inspection
Mechanical Components:
? Inspect arms, pivots, and shafts for cracks, deformation, or excessive wear
? Check pins and bushings for play and lubrication condition
? Tighten loose fasteners
Actuation System:

Hydraulic/Pneumatic Systems
? Inspect hoses, fittings, and cylinders for leaks
? Verify operating pressure is within specified limits
? Check cylinder rods for scoring or corrosion
Electrical Drives (if applicable)
? Inspect wiring and connectors
? Verify limit switches and position sensors function correctly
Functional Testing
? Operate the log flipper through full range of motion
? Confirm smooth, controlled movement without jerks or delays
? Verify end-position sensors stop motion correctly
Troubleshooting (General)
Symptom Possible Cause Corrective Action

Documentation and Records
? Record all inspections, tests, and maintenance actions
? Maintain lubrication logs
? Document safety device testing and validation results
? Retain records according to company and regulatory requirements
Spare Parts and Tools
? Maintain a critical spare parts list for chains, sprockets, sensors, and seals
? Use manufacturer-approved components only
? Keep calibrated measuring and testing tools available

procedures.procedureDescription:
Inspection Frequency
- Daily (Operator Check): Visual inspection of guards and E-stops
- Monthly: Functional testing of all safety devices
- Annually: Full safety audit and validation

Routine Inspection Tasks
- Verify all guards are securely fastened and free from damage
- Ensure E-stop buttons are accessible, labeled, and return properly
- Check interlocks for correct engagement and alignment
- Inspect cables, connectors, and conduits for wear or damage

Functional Testing
- Activate each E-stop and confirm immediate system stop
- Test guard interlocks to verify machine inhibition when opened
- Validate light curtain operation by interrupting the beam
- Confirm safety reset sequence operates correctly

Corrective Maintenance
- Replace faulty switches, sensors, or relays immediately
- Never bypass or disable safety devices
- Document all safety-related repairs and tests

customMethods.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	workOrderInfo = dict(self.view.custom.workOrderInfo)
	
	update = True if workOrderInfo['workOrderId'] else False
	
	if update:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.updateWorkOrder(workOrderInfo, userId)
		workOrderId = workOrderInfo['workOrderId']
		system.perspective.print("updateWorkOrder() called with %s returned %s %s"%(workOrderInfo, retVal, msg))
	else:
		workOrderId, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.addWorkOrder(workOrderInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.print("addWorkOrder() called with %s returned %s %s"%(workOrderInfo,workOrderId, msg))
		self.view.params.values.workOrderId = workOrderId		
		
	if msg is None:
		if workOrderInfo['scheduleTypeName'] == 'Recurring':
			workOrderScheduleInfo = dict(self.view.custom.workOrderSchedule)
			workOrderScheduleInfo['workOrderId'] = workOrderId
			workOrderScheduleInfo['lastGeneratedDate'] = None
			system.perspective.print("setWorkOrderSchedule() called with %s"%workOrderScheduleInfo)
			workOrderScheduleId, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.setWorkOrderSchedule(workOrderScheduleInfo, userId)
		elif workOrderInfo['scheduleTypeName'] == 'Condition':
			workOrderConditions = self.view.custom.workOrderConditions
			conditions = {item['conditionId']: item['conditionName'] for item in self.view.custom.conditions}
			conditionName = conditions[workOrderConditions['conditionId']]
			
			workOrderConditionInfo = {
			 							'workOrderConditionId': workOrderConditions['workOrderConditionId'],
			 							'workOrderId': workOrderId,
										'conditionId': workOrderConditions['conditionId'],
										'conditionInfo': system.util.jsonEncode(workOrderConditions[conditionName]),
										'lastGeneratedDate': workOrderConditions['lastGeneratedDate'],
										'lastGeneratedValue': workOrderConditions['lastGeneratedValue']
									}
			
			system.perspective.print("setWorkOrderCondition() called with %s"%workOrderConditionInfo)			
			workOrderScheduleId, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.setWorkOrderCondition(workOrderConditionInfo, userId)
		else:
			system.perspective.print("deleteWorkOrderSchedule() called with %s"%workOrderInfo['workOrderId'])
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrderSchedule(workOrderInfo['workOrderId'], userId)
			
			system.perspective.print("deleteWorkOrderCondition() called with %s"%workOrderInfo['workOrderId'])
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrderCondition(workOrderInfo['workOrderId'], userId)			
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "Couldn't delete this work order. %s"%msg})

	workOrderStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.cmms.getWorkOrderStatus({}), 'workOrderStatusName', 'workOrderStatusId')
	scheduleTypes = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.cmms.getScheduleTypes({}), 'scheduleTypeName', 'scheduleTypeId')
	
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Couldn't save work order. %s"%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Work order has been saved.'})
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.workOrderInfo")	

	if workOrderInfo['scheduleTypeId'] == scheduleTypes['One Time'] and workOrderInfo['workOrderStatusId'] == workOrderStates['Released'] and not update:
		#We should go ahead and create the workOrder event for this.
		system.perspective.print("Creating workOrder event")
		workOrderEventInfo = workOrderInfo
			
		serialId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('serialId', system.kanoa.serial.getSerialNumbers({'serialName': 'maintenanceWorkOrder'}))
		if serialId is None:
			serialId, msg = system.kanoa.serial.addSerialNumber({'enabled': True, 'prefix': 'MWO', 'serialName': 'maintenanceWorkOrder', 'zfill': 5}, userId)
		workOrderEventStatusInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.cmms.getWorkOrderEventStatus({'enabled': True}), 'workOrderEventStatusName', 'workOrderEventStatusId')
		workOrderEventStatusName = 'Assigned' if workOrderEventInfo['assignedTo'] else 'Open'
		workOrderEventInfo['workOrderEventStatusId'] = workOrderEventStatusInfo[workOrderEventStatusName]
		serialNumber, msg = system.kanoa.serial.getNextSerialNumber(serialId, userId)
		if msg:
			system.perspective.print(msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Couldn't save work order. %s"%msg})
			return
				
		workOrderEventInfo['workOrderEventName'] = serialNumber
		workOrderEventInfo['workOrderId'] = workOrderId
		workOrderEventInfo['assetId'] = workOrderInfo['assetId']
		workOrderEventId, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.addWorkOrderEvent(workOrderEventInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.print("addWorkOrderEvent() called with %s returned %s %s"%(workOrderEventInfo, workOrderEventId, msg))
	else:
		workOrderEventId = None
		workOrderEventStatusName = None

	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshWorkOrders', {'workOrderEventId': workOrderEventId, 'workOrderEventStatusName': workOrderEventStatusName})

	return workOrderId, msg
